meta.title: TM Travel | Discover Japan — Tailor-made Inbound Tours
lang.label: Language
hero.title: Discover the Soul of Japan
hero.sub: Tailor-made journeys from Tokyo's neon streets to Kyoto's quiet temples — planned by local experts who call Japan home.
intro.title: Your DMC partner on the ground in Japan
intro.body: TM Travel is a registered travel agency in Matsuyama, Ehime, on the island of Shikoku. Drawing on years of arranging trips for Japanese travelers, we now work as a destination management company (DMC) for travel agencies, tour operators and corporate clients abroad.
intro.body2: We take care of everything on the ground — hotels, transport, guides, experiences and events — and run each trip from the first quote to the final day, so your travelers enjoy Japan without a hitch.
f1.d: Hotels and ryokan, coaches, rail and transfers — contracted and coordinated by our team in Japan.
f2.d: Ready-made and tailor-made itineraries, with net rates and quick, clear quotations.
f3.d: Smooth communication with your team, and support for your travelers in their own language.
f4.d: A local contact on call throughout the trip, ready to solve problems on the spot.
dest.title: Where will Japan take you?
dest.sub: Unforgettable places we love to share with first-time visitors and returning travelers alike.
seasons.title: Every season, a different Japan
seasons.sub: Japan's four distinct seasons each bring their own colors, festivals and flavors. Choose yours.
partners.title: Your ground partner in Japan
partners.sub: We work behind the scenes for travel agencies, tour operators and corporate planners — so your travelers enjoy a seamless Japan, under your brand.
partners.d1: Net rates, ready-made and tailor-made itineraries, and white-label documents for your clients.
partners.d2: Incentive trips, meetings and events — venues, transport, guides and on-site staff.
partners.d3: Educational tours, school exchanges, and sports and culture programs, planned safely from start to finish.
cta.title: Your Japan story starts here
cta.body: Tell us how you dream of traveling. Our team will craft an itinerary made just for you.
step1.d: Dates, interests, group size and travel style.
step2.d: A personalized itinerary with transparent pricing.
step3.d: We take care of the details while you enjoy Japan.
meta.description: Tailor-made journeys across Japan — Tokyo, Kyoto, Mt. Fuji, Hokkaido, Okinawa and more — planned by TM Travel, a travel agency based in Matsuyama, Ehime.
